text_block_list.text:
Having claimed victory in the Satsuki Sho, 
Symboli Rudolf raised a single finger 
high, signaling the first crown. Her next 
goal is the Japan Derby.

Afterward, Air Groove and a general 
affairs Umamusume visited the waiting 
room. Before the two of them, Symboli 
Rudolf earnestly shared her dream.

Moved by those feelings, the general 
affairs Umamusume decided to stay in the 
student council. Meanwhile, Air Groove 
watched over the scene with a somewhat 
frustrated expression.
